title: Reflect device pricing
description: Two plans side by side, split by a hairline, over a huge glowing planet of violet light and its blurred reflection below: a small plan name, the price in a pink-to-lilac-to-periwinkle gradient (72px for a word, 32px for a phrase), a muted line and a button, then a line of small print. The planet fades in on entering the window and drifts upward as the section scrolls by. On phones the plans stack and the buttons stretch full width with their labels on the left.
notes: media is the planet (744×837 in the original); empty, a glow wash rounded at the bottom
the price gradient is chart-2 → chart-3 → chart-4
the tall bottom padding is room for the planet; designed for a dark theme
